value.title: An Astonishing Rescuer Appears! The True Meaning of a Partner!
value.synopsis: Toriko's expedition into the Gourmet World proves more dangerous than he expected, but luckily, someone back home is looking out for him. Will it be enough to keep him alive?

value.title: The Reunion of Toriko and Luffy! Find the Seafood Fruit!
value.synopsis: Toriko and Komatsu are seen fishing when Komatsu catches a Spring Shark. After defeating it, Luffy suddenly comes out of the Harusame's mouth and surprises Toriko and Komatsu. Soon, Sunny arrives and Chopper is revealed to be sick. In order to make him feel better, they have to find the "Seafood Fruit" and make Chopper eat it. Thus, Luffy, Toriko and the rest head off to Tou-Chinese Island.

value.title: Shock! The Broken Knife and Sharpener Melk!
value.synopsis: When Komatsu breaks his favorite knife, he and Toriko set out to find a famed craftsman who is said to forge the strongest blades imaginable - Melk! Their journey will not be easy, as it is plagued by Rock Wolves and Scale Kongs.

value.title: Tension! Toriko's Knife Vs Melk's Kitchen Knife!
value.synopsis: Toriko and Komatsu are shocked by who they find waiting at the home of Cutler Melk, and the legendary Gourmet Hunter's brash nature quickly leads to a knife fight!

value.title: Ultra Gravity! Take On Heavy Hole!
value.synopsis: Komatsu spends some quality time with Cutler Melk's apprentice, and Toriko delves deeper into the depths of Heavy Hole, where the gravity is intense and the Barbamoths are fierce!

value.title: Hidden Truth! Melk The First Appears!
value.synopsis: The intense gravity of Heavy Hole pushes Toriko's body to the breaking point. Back on the surface, Komatsu makes a shocking discovery about Culter Melk's apprentice!

value.title: Debut! Succeeding as the Second Generation and the Melk Stardust!
value.synopsis: Toriko delves into the various mysteries of Cutler Melk, including his unusual voice, and Komatsu uses his culinary skills to give Melk's apprentice a confidence boost!

value.title: A Work Made with All Her Might! The Completed Melk Knife!
value.synopsis: While Melk’s apprentice works tirelessly to craft a special knife for Komatsu, the little chef and Toriko wait eagerly for the job to be finished – and the feast to begin!

value.title: Super Celebs! The Dream Trip on the Gourmet Coach!
value.synopsis: Toriko and Komatsu take a trip on the luxurious Gourmet Carriage, but there's more to this vacation than sight-seeing and fine food. The adventurous duo is headed for the gates of hell!

value.title: He Finally Appears! The Last of the Four Heavenly Kings, Zebra!
value.synopsis: Toriko and Komatsu explore the despicable depths of Honey Prison as they make their way to the one called Zebra. Dare they hope to survive such a deafening encounter!?

value.title: Unleash the Roar! The Release of the Condemned Criminal Zebra!
value.synopsis: The one they call Zebra is released from prison just in time for Monster Season and a showdown with the horrifying Forrest Goblin! After he eats lunch, of course!

value.title: Warning Issued! Zebra Lands on Sand Garden!
value.synopsis: Komatsu voices his concerns about traveling with Zebra, who is a dangerous criminal. Zebra makes some new friends after a slugfest with a savage scorpion!

value.title: Komatsu Disappears! The Demonic Desert Labyrinth!
value.synopsis: A dangerous encounter with Desert Sharks leads to Komatsu's disappearance, which leads Toriko and Zebra to the foot of the Gourmet Pyramid!

value.title: Sealed Voice! The Different Dimension of Gourmet Pyramid!
value.synopsis: Komatsu is trapped within the labyrinthine Gourmet Pyramid, and only Zebra and Toriko can save him. Unfortunately, a deadly Gorgonclops and a hideous Unicorn Cerberus are standing in their way!

value.title: Bizarre! The Mysterious Ancient Document and the Creature in the Coffin!
value.synopsis: Zebra and Toriko must eat everything in their path in order to regain the strength needed for their daring rescue mission! Meanwhile, Komatsu struggles to survive on his own!

value.title: Shocking Showdown! Salamander Sphinx!
value.synopsis: Zebra and Toriko finally reunite with Komatsu, but their troubles are only just beginning. To acquire the Mellow Cola, they must defeat a ferocious Salamander Sphinx, but they have no idea how to kill it!

value.title: Cooperative Cooking! Komatsu Steers Toriko and Zebra!
value.synopsis: Zebra and Toriko carry out Komatsu’s brutal orders as the little chef tells them exactly how to harvest the Mellow Cola. Their mission is on the verge of success when an unseen evil emerges!

value.title: Explosion of Combination Techniques! Taking the World's Best Cola!
value.synopsis: Toriko and Zebra must work together to defeat the mysterious monster that attacked Komatsu. There's just one problem: the two warriors are completely out of energy!

value.title: The Truth Comes to Light! Komatsu's Will and the Identity of the Mysterious Creatures!
value.synopsis: Komatsu must find the courage to stand up to Zebra and tell the truth about who he wants to be his partner. Later, the horrifying identity of the mysterious monster from the Gourmet Pyramid is finally revealed!

value.title: Surpass Father! Mid-Summer Gatsugatsu Curry!
value.synopsis: Toriko's trip to the beach turns into an adventure when he agrees to help his favorite curry shop track down some much needed - and very dangerous - ingredients! First on the list: Water Tiger!

value.title: Connecting Bonds! The Supoerb Gatsugatsu Curry!
value.synopsis: Toriko continues his heated battle with powerful Water Tiger, and Komatsu helps a heartbroken chef find the amazing curry cooking skills locked inside him!

value.title: A New Stage! Toriko's Determination and the Return of
value.synopsis: Toriko's quest to get stronger leads the dynamic culinary duo to a remote cafe in the centre of a pitch black lake. The food is delicious , but the client is deadly!

value.title: Overflowing Food Luck! A Pilgrimage to Gourmet Shrine!
value.synopsis: Toriko and Komatsu visit the legendary Gourmet Shrine where they seek to increase their food luck! After sampling many delicacies and taking in the sights, Komatsu takes center stage for a surprising feat of strength!

value.title: UWAAH! The Astonishing Surprise Apples!
value.synopsis: Toriko and Komatsu hope to have the element of surprise on their side as they travel to the explosive Surprise Island in search of the legendary Surprise Apple!

value.title: Chicken Egg! Memories of Old Man Yocchi and his Wife
value.synopsis: After his recent lottery win, Komatsu wants to buy Toriko a gift. There's just one problem. The legendary gourmet hunter has his heart set on a priceless piece of land where the Chicken Beast lays its eggs!

value.title: Glistening of a Crystal! Shining Gourami!
value.synopsis: Toriko, Komatsu, and Sunny embark on a hair-raising quest to track down the Shining Gourami, an extremely rare sea creature that lives deep within Death Falls!

value.title: Impact of the Raging Rapids! The Giant Waterfall, the Death Falls!
value.synopsis: As the quest for the Shining Gourami continues, Toriko grows more and more impressed with Sunny's training. An unexpected battle with a Hippo Shark gives the rainbow-haired gourmet hunter a chance to show off his strength!

value.title: Sani's New Technique! The Fruits of Magnificent Training!
value.synopsis: The devastating power of Death Falls sends Sunny into a flashback where he reflects on the days spent battling beasts and honing his instincts on the Road of Three Hells!

value.title: A Combined 30-Fold! 36 Ren Twin Kugi Punch!
value.synopsis: Toriko and Sunny must team up for a powerful combination move that's their only hope for surviving the journey through Death Falls! But even if they reach the other side, they'll need help to capture their prey.

value.title: Intuition Cooking! Komatsu and the Shining Gourami!
value.synopsis: Komatsu takes center stage as the little chef struggles to unlock the secret to preparing the Shining Gourami! Toriko and Sunny are exhausted and hungry, and Komatsu must listen to his ingredients if he wants to feed his friends!

value.title: A Super Extravagant Production! The Ultimate Meal Service!
value.synopsis: When Melk the Second needs help finishing a very special knife, Toriko and Komatsu compete in a prestigious competition in an attempt to win the final ingredient needed to complete her project!

value.title: The Finest Chitose Ame! Komatsu and Yun's Tale
value.synopsis: Toriko and Komatsu are summoned to the Gourmet Temple to help the priests and staff in creating a very special candy but during the whole process of the two assisting the Temple Priests in making and finding the special ingredient for the creation of this candy, Yun who has hitched along with Toriko and Komatsu ends up going missing making Komatsu try and search for the baby Wall Penguin before something happens to him.

value.title: A Gathering at Autumn Mountain! Terrym Yun, Kiss, and Quin!
value.synopsis: Toriko, Komatsu, Yun and Terry all work with Sunny and Coco, who, along with their own animal partners, each hunt for a very special ingredient and end up finding a surprise along the way.

value.title: Reunion! Take-chan of Otogi Castle!
value.synopsis: A sinister force is abducting the top chefs in the world, and an old friend of Komatsu’s may be in great danger! Elsewhere, Toriko and Coco attempt to capture a rare appetizer!

value.title: A Parting of Ways! The Goals of Chefs
value.synopsis: Komatsu is shocked by the lack of culinary honor exhibited by his old friend. Meanwhile, Toriko and Coco team up to open a giant treasure chest - but what they find inside leaves them baffled!

value.title: Dramatic Transformation - The Beauty Parlor, Barber Gourmet!
value.synopsis: Toriko and Komatsu reunite for some much needed rest and relaxation at a gourmet barber shop. The food is superb, but their hair may never recover!

value.title: The Four Heavenly Kings Assemble! Miracle in Midwinter!
value.synopsis: Toriko, Sunny, Coco, and Komatsu brave frigid temperatures and Bison Frogs as they search for a legendary tree that's entirely edible!

value.title: Merry Itadakimasu! Gourmet Santa's Presents!
value.synopsis: Chief Mansam recruits Toriko and the whole gang to help spread tasty Christmas cheer to hungry kids across the world! Even Zebra manages a good deed by mistake, and the holiday ends with a delicious miracle!

value.title: Heaven or Hell?! Plunge into Gourmet Casino!
value.synopsis: Toriko, Komatsu, and Coco venture into the Pleasure Zone on quest to track down some extremely rare Meteor Garlic, but they soon cross paths with an old friend who could use their help!

value.title: Appearance! The Boss of the Underground Cooking World, Livebearer!
value.synopsis: Toriko and the gang make a splash at the casino as they attempt to win enough cash and ingredients to gain admittance to the VIP area, but what lies ahead could prove deadly!

value.title: A Card Game with Your Life on the Line! Gourmet Tasting!
value.synopsis: Toriko, Komatsu, and Coco go head-to-head with Livebearer in a game of Gourmet Memory that could cost the loser all their memories of ever eating food!

value.title: Dead Heat! Coco vs Livebearer
value.synopsis: Coco and Livebearer continue their epic showdown, but Toriko does most of the heavy lifting, devouring a mountain of pudding and handful of acorns as hard as bullets!

value.title: Coco's Strategy! The Big-Miss Cards That Determine the Outcome!
value.synopsis: The deadly game unfolding between Coco and Livebearer reaches an unprecedented level of danger as Toriko must face off against a fearsome Hanya Panda to avoid the agony of defeat!

value.title: Eat or Be Eaten! Toriko vs. the Hannya Panda!
value.synopsis: Toriko's slugfest with the Hanya Panda proves to be more brutal than expected, and even if he survives, the difference between victory and defeat may ultimately lie with Komatsu!

value.title: Climax! The Remaining Worst Ingredients!
value.synopsis: Toriko keeps his team in the game by surviving mouthfuls of Shock Lemons and Nitro Cherries, but if Livebearer can withstand a bite of poison potato - all will be lost!

value.title: The Moment of Conclusion! Coko's Sublime Scenario!
value.synopsis: The true genius of Coco's plan is finally revealed as Livebearer finds himself unable to eat the poison potato, but the memory-devouring madman won't go down without a fight!

value.title: A Taste That's Out of this World! The Actual Eating of the Meteor Garlic!
value.synopsis: Komatsu gets help preparing the Meteor Garlic from a very unexpected source, and Granny Setsu is paid a visit by the IGO!

value.title: Pinnacle Showdown! Ichiryuu vs the Bishokukai's Midora!
value.synopsis: Toriko searches for more training ingredients, Komatsu impresses his boss with dazzling new cooking techniques, and Ichiryu comes face-to-face with an old nemesis!

value.title: The Hidden Training Ingredient! Emergency Instructions from Ichiryuu!
value.synopsis: Before beginning the search for his next training ingredient, Toriko must defeat a ferocious Devil Plant Horse and then dine with a fortune telling sushi chef!
